description: Extract text content from a file. Supports PDF, DOCX, CSV, JSON, Markdown, HTML, and code files. Pass file content as base64 (for binary formats like PDF/DOCX) or raw text (for text formats). Returns extracted text, word count, and processing time.

content.description: File content — base64-encoded for binary formats (PDF, DOCX), raw text for text formats

name: extract_text
